hero.title: Citizen voice & accountability
hero.subtitle: Strengthening participation, especially for women and youth, and building bridges between communities, decision-makers and service providers.

programme.heading: The Programme
programme.intro: Creating space for communities to be heard
programme.text1: EmpowerKids–South Sudan's Advocacy & Civic Engagement programme works to strengthen citizen participation, community voice and accountability.
programme.text2: We create opportunities for community members to understand their rights, raise concerns, engage with local leaders and participate constructively in decisions that affect their lives.
programme.text3: Our work places particular emphasis on creating space for women, youth and other groups whose voices may not always be represented in public decision-making.

civicInAction.intro: From community concerns to constructive dialogue

cards.title: Community Dialogue Series
cards.description: Regular, facilitated dialogues bring community members together with local leaders and service providers. These conversations provide a structured space for residents to raise concerns, discuss community priorities and propose solutions.

cards.title: Councillors for Citizens
cards.description: Supporting elected local representatives to become more responsive and connected to the communities they serve. The initiative encourages councillors to hold community meetings, listen to citizen priorities, report back and take action.

cards.title: Civic Awareness
cards.description: Civic awareness sessions help community members understand rights, governance and opportunities to participate in public processes, with emphasis on women and youth.

cards.title: Community–Authority Engagement
cards.description: EKSS facilitates constructive engagement between communities, local authorities and service providers around issues affecting everyday life.

featuredInitiative.title: Councillors for Citizens
featuredInitiative.subtitle: Building stronger connections between citizens and elected representatives
featuredInitiative.description: Councillors for Citizens supports elected local representatives to maintain stronger relationships with the communities they serve. The initiative creates opportunities for councillors to meet residents, listen to community priorities, report back and respond to issues raised by citizens.
